Headline: #21 Cermak Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Cermak/Ogden
ShortDescription: Eastbound 21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted, due to street blockage near Cermak/Ogden.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted via Cermak, Ogden, Central Park, 16th, Kedzie, then resume their normal route, due to street blockage near Cermak/Ogden.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
